title: 第14章 变化第15章 庇护
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 李沐颜檀口微张，直到那道身影飘然落在身前，带着惊喜的声音才脱口而出。
“长青……你突破了？”
此刻，那道御剑而来的身影不是沈长青又是谁。
沈长青飘然落地，掐了个手诀将法剑收入储物袋中，他注视着眼前这张无暇的雪颜，微笑着点点头，道：“今日午时突破的，现在我已是剑观的正式弟子了。”
“好小子，果然没让我们失望。”
一声大笑从正堂内走出，李彦君笑的十分畅快，像是将胸腔中压抑多时的郁气一口吐了出来。
他来到近前，重重的拍着沈长青的肩膀，“算算时间，你加入太虚剑观不过才两个月吧。”
沈长青注意到自己这位岳父终日不展的眉梢如今终得舒展，他拱手拜谢：“若非岳父与岳母大人所赠的聚气丹，长青断然无法这么快突破。”
“第一次突破就成功，这可不是吞服多少聚气丹就能做到的。”洛秋华也走了出来，她看着自己这个女婿，眼中带着深深的讶然与审视，好似第一次认识这位女婿。
以沈长青二十岁突破养气境后期的资质，两个月的时间，断然只能是第一次突破，而一次就成功突破，着实出乎了所有人的预料。
洛秋华惊讶之余便是如释重负的欣慰，“长青，你真是给我们了一个天大的惊喜。”
“还好当初爹娘的人情没有白白送出去。”
李沐颜似是有些得意道：“也不知道我师傅知道你一次就突破成功后会是什么表情。”
当初曲孤岚曾断言沈长青或无望聚灵，自那日以后，这位神变境强者的话便犹如一块大石一样，终日堵在他们一家的心口处。
而今日，沈长青则用自己的实际行动彻底打破了这块大石。
“是啊，要知道，当初沈家那个‘宝贝天才’突破聚灵境之时尚且用了两次才成功。”
谈及沈家，李彦君的语气顿时多了几分冷意，他说着，又突然看向沈长青，道：“对了，长青，你还不知道吧，那沈长瑞前两天已经在尝试突破化丹境了。”
“化丹境。”沈长青眉头一挑，倒是没想到他那个天才弟弟的修行速度竟然这么快。
算算时间，如今沈长瑞加入学宫不过才一年零几个月的时间罢了。
“不错。”
李彦君呵呵一笑，嗤讽道：“那小子确实也算得上是个天才，再加上沈家不计代价的供养他，一年多的时间摸到化丹境的门槛倒也在情理之中，只是可惜啊，他的第一次又失败了。”
李沐颜眸光微动，却没什么情绪。
倒是沈长青突然冷笑了起来，“这么看，现在的沈家，倒是很适合我上门讨债啊。”
“讨债？”
李沐颜转眸过来，一脸好奇的看着他，“长青，讨什么债。”
李彦君与洛秋华也竖起了耳朵。
沈长青也没卖关子，当即把他与沈正峰夫妇签订了学宫契书一事说了出来。
“沈家答应我说若我能突破聚灵境，便为我缴纳一年的束脩，现在我也突破了，正好明天就去把那一百二十枚灵石拿回来。”
他有些恶趣味的一笑。
“我要和你一起去。”
李沐颜眼睛突然亮了起来，沈家如今的情绪正低沉，若他们得知被自己当做弃子的长子已经成功踏入聚灵境，且还是一次就成功，他们的表情恐怕会很精彩。
有这种好事她怎么能错过？
“同去同去。”李彦君来了兴趣。
“好了好了，你好歹也是一家之主，就别去凑这种热闹了。”
洛秋华扯了李彦君一下，后者顿时哈哈一笑，她旋即又对两人道：“长青刚突破，如今正是该好好休息的时候，颜儿，你们快回去吧。”
“知道啦，娘~”
李沐颜带着沈长青离开了。
content_en:
Li Muyantan opened her mouth slightly, and it was not until the figure floated down in front of her that she blurted out a voice full of surprise.
"Evergreen...have you made a breakthrough?"
At this moment, the figure coming with the sword was someone else but Shen Changqing.
"Yeah."
Shen Changqing landed on the ground, made a hand gesture and put the magic sword into the storage bag. He stared at the flawless snowy face in front of him, smiled and nodded, and said: "I made a breakthrough at noon today, and now I am an official disciple of Sword Temple."
"Good boy, you really didn't disappoint us."
A loud laugh came out of the main hall, and Li Yanjun laughed very freely, as if he was letting out the depression that had been suppressed in his chest for a long time.
He came closer and patted Shen Changqing's shoulder heavily, "Calculating the time, it has only been two months since you joined Taixu Sword Temple."
Shen Changqing noticed that his father-in-law's eyebrows that had been sluggish all day were now finally relaxed. He bowed his hands and thanked him: "If it hadn't been for the Qi Gathering Pill given by my father-in-law and mother-in-law, Changqing would never have been able to break through so quickly."
"Succeeding in the first breakthrough cannot be achieved by swallowing many Qi Gathering Pills." Luo Qiuhua also walked out. She looked at her son-in-law with deep surprise and scrutiny in her eyes, as if she was meeting this son-in-law for the first time.
With Shen Changqing's qualifications to break through to the late stage of Nourishing Qi Realm at the age of twenty, he could only break through for the first time in two months. To succeed in the first time was beyond everyone's expectations.
Luo Qiuhua was surprised and relieved, "Changqing, you really gave us a big surprise."
"Fortunately, the favor from my parents was not given away in vain."
Li Muyan seemed to be a little proud and said: "I don't know what my master's expression will be when he knows that you succeeded in breaking through in one try."
At the beginning, Qu Gulan had asserted that Shen Changqing might have no hope of gathering souls. From that day on, the words of this powerful man in the Divine Transformation Realm were like a big stone, blocking the hearts of their family all day long.
Today, Shen Changqing used his actual actions to completely break this rock.
"Yes, you must know that the 'baby genius' of the Shen family broke through to the spirit gathering realm and it took him two attempts to succeed."
Talking about the Shen family, Li Yanjun's tone suddenly became a little colder. As he spoke, he suddenly looked at Shen Changqing and said, "By the way, Changqing, you don't know, but Shen Changrui was already trying to break through the realm of alchemy two days ago."
"Alchemy realm." Shen Changqing raised his eyebrows, but he didn't expect that his genius brother's cultivation speed would be so fast.
Calculating the time, it has only been a year and a few months since Shen Changrui joined the academy.
"Not bad."
Li Yanjun chuckled and said sarcastically: "That boy is indeed a genius. In addition, the Shen family supports him at all costs. It is reasonable for him to reach the threshold of the Alchemy Realm in more than a year. It's just a pity that he failed again the first time."
Li Muyan's eyes moved slightly, but there was no emotion.
But Shen Changqing suddenly sneered, "Looking at it this way, the current Shen family is quite suitable for me to come to collect debts."
"Debt collection?"
Li Muyan turned around and looked at him curiously, "Changqing, what kind of debt are you asking for?"
Li Yanjun and Luo Qiuhua also pricked up their ears.
Shen Changqing didn't show off, and immediately told him about the academy deed he signed with Shen Zhengfeng and his wife.
"The Shen family promised me that if I can break through to the Spirit Gathering Realm, they will pay me a year of cultivation. Now that I have broken through, I will go and get the one hundred and twenty spirit stones back tomorrow."
He smiled a bit evilly.
"I'm going with you."
Li Muyan's eyes suddenly lit up. The Shen family was in a low mood now. If they knew that their eldest son, whom they regarded as an abandoned son, had successfully entered the Soul Gathering Realm, and had succeeded in the first attempt, their expressions would probably be very exciting.
How could she miss such a good thing?
"Let's go together." Li Yanjun became interested.
"Okay, okay, you are the head of the family after all, so don't join in the fun."
Luo Qiuhua tugged at Li Yanjun, who immediately laughed. She immediately said to the two of them: "Chang Qing has just made a breakthrough, and now it's time to take a good rest. Yan'er, please go back quickly."
"I know, mother~"
Li Muyan left with Shen Changqing.
